subject: PrivDeploy licensing staircase and SLA anchoring
messages:
From: Gina Torres <gina@primemed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PrimeMed Procurement <procurement@primemed.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify private deploy pricing: platform fee amortization & support tiers

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team liked the latency/commit story. Procurement asked me to get a clean summary of how you price private deployments for PrimeMed's finance review. Two specific asks: 

1) How does the platform fee get applied across a multi-site cluster? Can it be amortized monthly vs invoiced up-front?
2) We need an SKU matrix showing node vs seat licensing, and what support tier (SRE oncall, response windows) maps to each SKU.

We have a target to finalize commercial terms before the Nov 12 budget committee. If you can send a one-page matrix and an SOW template we can share with legal, that would help. Also include any early-adopter credits or implementation discounts you can offer for a 3-year committed GPU volume.

Attaching our vendor checklist (procurement wants to validate SOC2 + retention terms early).

Best,
Gina Torres
Director, Procurement
PrimeMed

Attachment: vendor_compliance_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Gina Torres <gina@primemed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify private deploy pricing: platform fee amortization & support tiers

Gina — thanks, and appreciate the timeline. Short answer up-front: we can amortize the platform fee monthly for accounting (invoiceable monthly with a prepay option) and we offer a 3-year commit discount structure that materially reduces the effective platform fee.

I attached a compact matrix that shows the two primary packaging axes:
- Node-first (per-GPU unit): predictable throughput pricing, better for persistent inference (recommended at PrimeMed scale)
- Seat-first (per-concurrent-seat or per-endpoint): simpler for small pilot deployments

Also included: support ladder mapping (Standard / Enhanced / Premier) with response SLAs and included SRE hours. Quick highlights:
- Standard: 24x5 ticket triage, business-hours responses
- Enhanced: 24x7 triage + 4-hour P1 response, monthly runbook reviews
- Premier: dedicated SRE retainer, priority routing, quarterly on-site planning (optional)

Attached: pricing_by_node_vs_seat.xlsx and privdeploy_tier_summary.pdf (one-pager). I put Ben on the thread for SOW/SLA detail.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call this afternoon or tomorrow to walk the matrix and produce a redline-ready SOW. If you prefer, we can also present a simple amortization schedule for the platform fee.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Exec — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_by_node_vs_seat.xlsx (spreadsheet), privdeploy_tier_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Gina Torres <gina@primemed.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify private deploy pricing: platform fee amortization & support tiers

Hi Gina — Ben here (SE). Adding a few technical-commercial tradeoffs that typically matter to customers at PrimeMed's scale: 

- If you expect sustained GPU utilization > 70% we recommend node-first licensing; it minimizes per-token cost and simplifies autoscaling SLAs.
- Seat-based licensing is useful for latency-bounded clinician-facing endpoints with predictable active sessions; note that seat pricing includes a small premium for single-tenant isolation.
- Platform fee: can be amortized monthly; for a 3-year commit we usually provide a 15–25% uplift discount on the platform fee depending on committed GPU-hours.
- Implementation credit: we can offer a one-time professional services credit that offsets the first invoice (applies to SOW scope limited to onboarding and validation).

I've attached an SOW draft (sow_privdeploy_draft.docx) with two optional blocks: (A) on-call retainer (Premier) and (B) block hours for integrations. For the finance team, see the attached implementation_credit_calculation.csv with worked examples showing amortized platform fee impact.

If you want numbers in the form PrimeMed prefers, tell me the committed GPU-type and a conservative utilization profile and I will produce a 12/36 month amortized invoice schedule.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sow_privdeploy_draft.docx (docx), implementation_credit_calculation.csv (csv)
From: Gina Torres <gina@primemed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PrimeMed Procurement <procurement@primemed.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify private deploy pricing: platform fee amortization & support tiers

Thanks Ben/Tessa — that helps. A few asks from procurement/legal before we move to PO: 

1) PrimeMed preference is to amortize the platform fee monthly with net-30 invoices; please show a 12-month amortization in a format our FP&A can validate.
2) Procurement would like to see a first-year platform-fee concession — baseline ask is 25% off the platform fee in year one. Alternatively, a 15% fee + an implementation credit that nets to the same economics would be okay.
3) We need SOC2 report and an overview of your data retention and access controls for on-prem telemetry.
4) Contractually, our legal team wants a 90-day SLA remedy ladder (credits) for sustained P1 incidents. Can you clarify what credits map to Premier vs Enhanced?

If you can provide a 12-month amortized invoice mock (line items + invoice totals), SOC2 upload, and a redlineable SOW we can route to legal. Our deadline for the finance committee is EOD Nov 12; is that workable?

Attachment: vendor_compliance_checklist.xlsx (procurement version)

Regards,
Gina
Director, Procurement — PrimeMed
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Gina Torres <gina@primemed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T15:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify private deploy pricing: platform fee amortization & support tiers

Gina — thanks for the clarity and the timeline. We can meet the Nov 12 deadline. Concessions / deliverables we will provide by COB Nov 9 to give you time for legal: 

- A 12-month amortization workbook (line-item invoice mock) showing monthly platform-fee amortization and invoice totals (includes the implementation credit applied to month 1).
- Commercial concession: we can offer a 20% reduction to the platform fee in Year 1 + a one-time implementation credit equivalent to 5% of Year 1 platform invoice. If PrimeMed prefers the 25% up-front discount, we can escalate to the VP for an additional 5% concession but that would require a signed LOI by Nov 9.
- SLA credits ladder: full mapping in the SOW draft (P1 sustained > 30 minutes => credit equal to 5% of monthly platform fee per incident, escalates for repeated events; Premier has higher priority and enumerated runbook obligations).
- SOC2: we will share the auditor package and a short on-prem telemetry access statement (redacted) via the Drive link.

Next steps: Irene (CC'd) will take the legal handoff and produce a redline-friendly SOW guidance doc. Ben will deliver the amortization workbook. Can you confirm whether PrimeMed needs a PO or an initial LOI to lock the concession?

If LOI is acceptable, we can circulate a short LOI template today. Otherwise we will prepare the numbers for PO issuance.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Exec — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_guidance_for_privdeploy.docx (docx)
